description: Requires the connected Fold account, and only returns data when that login belongs to a Fold business (B2B) account such as a hotel, office or property-management company. For each such account: this month's deliveries and running total, the last three months' statement totals, payments, balance and due date, an open invoice payment link if one exists, and the scheduled delivery days. Read-only.
name: get_business_account
title: Business account summary
